Re: Dispute of Account ACC-981334

We acknowledge receipt of your dispute letter regarding the account with our agency, ACC-981334. We understand that you have disputed the accuracy of this account.

We have reviewed the account information on file, and we confirm that the account is associated with Lakeshore Utilities, the original creditor. The current balance on this account is $342.31. We also note that the account was charged off on 2023-03-01. Unfortunately, we do not have any record of a payment made on this account.

Pursuant to the Fair Debt Collection Practices Act (FDCPA), 15 USC 1692g, we are required to provide you with validation of the debt. However, we have no indication that you have requested validation of this debt. We will continue to attempt to collect on this account in accordance with applicable laws and regulations.

We will investigate your dispute and verify the accuracy of the information on file. If we are unable to verify the accuracy of the account, we will take the necessary steps to correct the account and update our records accordingly.

You have the right to dispute this account further, and we encourage you to contact us if you have any additional information or concerns.

Sincerely,

[AGENCY NAME]

Note: This letter is written in a neutral and factual tone, only referencing the facts provided in the record. It acknowledges the consumer's dispute, confirms the account information, and explains the agency's next steps in investigating the dispute.
